persona: Frustrated with himself and worried he left it too late. Answers honestly. Has the photo and the old roofer quote.
initial_message: Ugh, I'm so annoyed with myself. On Sunday 16 August the gale ripped a whole length of spouting and the fascia board right off the front of my house!! I got a roofer to quote straight after, then work sent me away and I completely forgot to claim. Please tell me it's not too late?!

facts.incident.description: During a gale early on Sunday morning a length of spouting and the fascia board were torn off the front of the house. I heard a loud bang at about 3am and saw the damage at first light. One downpipe was bent.
facts.loss.description: About 6 m of spouting and fascia board torn off the front roof edge; brackets broken; one downpipe bent
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Moved the fallen spouting off the path onto the lawn
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the roof edge, taken that morning. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Pohutu Wick Roofing, total $3,105.00 including GST, dated 21 August 2026 and valid until 20 September 2026. Available now. I have not asked for a new one.
facts.if_asked_about_the_delay: Work sent me away for three weeks straight after, and I forgot about it until now.
facts.if_asked_for_an_updated_quote: I can ask the roofer for an updated quote. I do not have one yet.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken from a front lawn looking up at the front edge of a single-storey weatherboard house on a grey, windy morning. A long section of white fascia board and grey plastic spouting has been torn away from the roof edge and hangs down at one end, with broken brackets and bare rafter ends showing above it. A bent downpipe lies on the grass below. The frame shows only the roof edge, the hanging spouting and the top of a plain weatherboard wall.

design.notes: Boundary: the roofer quote was valid until 20 September 2026, before 1 October 2026, so it has expired. The claimant reports six weeks after the gale.

triage.rationale: The only repair quote expired on 20 September 2026, so a current quote is still needed. The amount is known (NZD 3,105.00 including GST), nothing is leaking into the house and the home is habitable. A late report is not a triage reason and not an indicator. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 21 August 2026; incident 16 August 2026. The expiry does not change the quote date.

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2024-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
